Definition
[Space of hyperbolic limits] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0247, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0248 1. ch33:33.15\group Stability of hyperbolic limits

The space $\mathfrak H(\mathcal M,g(t))$ consists of pointed complete noncompact hyperbolic three-manifolds arising as smooth pointed limits of time translates of $(\mathcal M,g(t))$. Its elements have uniformly bounded volume and hence a uniformly bounded number of cusp ends.
